newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - March 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - March 27.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Thursday's Daily Variety:
* The Oscar's live audience gave the show's venue -- the Shrine Auditorium -- less than dazzling reviews.
* Tribune Co has increased its ownership in WB Television Network to 21.9 percent. Time Warner and Tribune have been partners in WB since its launch more than two years ago.

* French production company Ciby 2000 has been looking for new shareholders since Cannes last year. French communications group Havas was also looking at the idea of buying Ciby 2000 but not Walt Disney, sources said.
* Hearst Corp is buying Argyle Television Inc. and merging it into its TV station group to form a $1.8 billion public company called Hearst-Argyle Television Inc.
* Investors sold Viacom stock Wednesday in reaction to analyst warnings that the entertainment conglomerate's earnings in the first and second quarters would be less than expected.
